The '''2019 Sullust Regionals''' were a regional championship held on 7 September 2019 at Tuan Kiadó, a bookshop and game café on Andrássy út in Budapest, Hungary. [[Tamás Papp]] was the tournament director. Ten players entered. [[Quirin Fürgut]] won on strength of schedule over [[Angelo Consoli]], both 5–1, defending his title.<ref name="sul">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=71258 Sullust Regional - 7th September 2019 in Budapest, Hungary], forum.starwarsccg.org (29 November 2018 – 10 September 2019). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105004324/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t71258.html Internet Archive]</ref>

The field's Light Side decks were 2 TRM, 2 Legend, RST, Diplo, EBO, HITCO, TIGIH and non-flipping YOps; the Dark Side decks were 2 AOBS, 2 MAP, EOps troopers, EOps mains, HD, Invasion, a Destroyer Droid Dark Deal deck and flipping SYCFA.<ref name="sul" />
